title: Bluegrass by the Sea | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk home: * 2 Master suites and 2 Living Areas* 4 Bikes Included* 6 Seater Electric Golf Cart Available for an additional $100/nt (Please note: a $500 refundable deposit is required)* 2 Large Porches for Relaxing and Dining
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk home: * 2 Master suites and 2 Living Areas* 4 Bikes Included* 6 Seater Electric Golf Cart Available for an additional $100/nt (Please note: a $500 refundable deposit is required)* 2 Large Porches for Relaxing and Dining* Stainless Steel Gas Grill and Outdoor Shower, 4 Beach chairs* Quiet Neighborhood, with bike and walking trails, and surrounded by Point Washington State Forest* Access to "The Gathering Place" with Pools, Hammocks, Grills, and Fire Pit* Walking or Biking Distance to Fabulous Shopping and Dining Options* Next to Watercolor and Seaside* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 ServiceCome experience Bluegrass by the Sea in the NatureWalk 30A Resort Community, and discover a wonderful vacation home surrounded by numerous bike and walking trails. Step inside this large 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home to find a haven of rest and relaxation. The living area features plenty of seating around a large flat-screen TV. The chef in your group will love the gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a 5-burner gas range. This home sleeps up to 9 guests comfortably with a King Master suite on the first floor, and then an additional King Suite, Queen Guest Bedroom, and a bunk room with a Twin-Over-Queen bunkbed on the second floor. Step outside to find the two large porches, an outdoor shower, and a stainless steel gas grill. This home also features some extras to enhance your stay, including a 6-seater electric golf cart ($100/nt extra) and 4 bikes. Take the included bikes to the beach, or enjoy one of the community pools, whatever you decide to do Bluegrass by the Sea will show you why it brings families back year after year.* This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * * Garage access is limited to the golf cart and included bikes**Due to an HOA restriction, boats, RVs, and trailers are not allowed in this neighborhood**Guests will be charged $150 for a lost or missing amenity pass. Please leave the amenity pass at home upon departure. *The Bed Setup1st Floor:Master Suite: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Suite: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedBunk Room: Twin-over-Queen Bunkbed NatureWalk 30A is ideally located on Hwy 395 off of 30A, next to Watercolor and Seaside. NatureWalk is surrounded by Point Washington State Forest, and Grayton Beach State Park and Western Lake are located nearby. Explore the endless trails by bike or on foot. Rent a kayak or paddleboard and explore Western Lake or the Gulf at Grayton Beach State Park. NatureWalk features “The Gathering Place” which boasts a large zero-entry pool, a heated lap pool, hot tub, lounge chairs, tables and chairs, a shaded kiddie pool, hammocks, an outdoor kitchen with gas grills, and a gas fire pit for family enjoyment. Additional amenities include 2 playgrounds, volleyball courts, pickleball, and basketball. Walk or bike less than a mile to the “San Juan Beach Access” via the “Lilly Lane Beach Trail” through the beautiful Point Washington State Forest. Several additional beach accesses are also located along 30A within 1 mile. Publix is conveniently located next to our neighborhood in “Watercolor Crossings”. There you will also find Pizza by the Sea, Boca Boutique, UPS Store, Emerald Coast Wine and Spirits, Perfect Pig Restaurant, Pedego Electric Bikes, and Yellowfin Sports, to meet all of your needs. The shops and restaurants of Seaside, Watercolor, and Seagrove Beach are a short bike ride away. Also visit the funky shops and restaurants in Old Grayton Beach just down 30A.)Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along the 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayaking, paddleboarding, biking, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. Seaside is a fantastic destination within walking distance and is most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It's incredible architecture has helped to make it famous, but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
